entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please say 'support' or 'sales' to continue.
Connecting you to the next available agent.
Thank you for calling VeloFit, my name is Isaac. How can I help you today?
Hi, I need to make a return. I'm just so disappointed this didn't work out.
I'm sorry to hear that. I can certainly look into the return for you. Do you have the order number handy?
Yes, it's VF886-01. I tried to do this online over a week ago but the system just wasn't working. I've been a loyal customer for years and I really needed this money back.

Thank you. Let me pull that up... Okay, I see the VeloBand Cadence Sensor, delivered on December 15th. I understand you had trouble with the website. To make sure I understand correctly, what specifically was the issue when you tried to process the return online?

I went to the return page, but after I filled everything in, I got a big **website error** message. The whole return **system** seemed to be **down**. I even took a **screenshot** on my phone because I was so worried. I tried a few more times but I **couldn't print** the label or get it to go through.
I see. Thank you for that detail. Do you remember the approximate date you were trying to do this?
It was about nine or ten days after I got it, right before Christmas. It was very stressful.

Let me check our system logs for that timeframe... one moment... Yes, I am seeing a record of a known outage with our return portal around December 24th. I sincerely apologize that you were affected by that.
Oh, so it wasn't just me? That makes me feel a little better.

No, it was a technical fault on our end. In any case, looking at your purchase date, you are well within the 90-day return period listed in our policy. So I can absolutely get this processed for you right now. I'm generating a return shipping label and sending it to the email on file. Is that okay?
Oh, thank you so much! Yes, that's perfect. That's such a relief. I really appreciate your help, Isaac.
You're very welcome. Once we receive the item back at our warehouse, you'll see a full refund to your original payment method in 3-5 business days. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
No, that's everything. Thank you again.
My pleasure. Thank you for being a VeloFit customer, and have a great rest of your day.
